mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO object_storage_backend_identity (singleton_id, provider, filesystem_root, s3_bucket, s3_region, s3_endpoint, s3_path_style) VALUES (1, #{provider}, #{filesystemRoot}, #{s3Bucket}, #{s3Region}, #{s3Endpoint}, #{s3PathStyle})
mapper.select: SELECT provider, filesystem_root AS filesystemRoot, s3_bucket AS s3Bucket, s3_region AS s3Region, s3_endpoint AS s3Endpoint, s3_path_style AS s3PathStyle FROM object_storage_backend_identity WHERE singleton_id = 1
